title: Mother Holding 4-Month-Old Baby by House, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage outdoor snapshot of a woman lovingly holding a four-month-old baby in her arms outside a suburban home with horizontal clapboard siding and a wooden trellis. The woman sports a stylish 1970s windowpane plaid blazer over a dark skirt or trousers. The deckle-edged photograph is stamped on the reverse side on Kodak Velox paper with handwritten notations recording the baby's age.
